name: Frecuencia de Voz Pasiva
description: Analyzes the ratio and distribution of passive voice constructions, which AI text tends to overuse compared to human writing.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated text through systematic overuse of passive voice constructions
mechanism: Identifies passive voice constructions by analyzing auxiliary verb + past participle patterns and dependency parse structures. Computes the passive-to-active ratio per paragraph and its variance. AI-generated text, particularly from instruction-tuned models, tends to use passive voice more uniformly than humans, who naturally vary voice usage based on emphasis, stylistic preference, and information structure.
source: Herbold, S. et al. (2023) - A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays, Scientific Reports
algorithm: Dependency Parse Voice Detection + Ratio Analysis + Variance Measurement
parameters: Detection method: dependency parse patterns, Granularity: per-paragraph, Metrics: passive ratio, passive variance, passive clustering
strengths:
• Captures a known stylistic bias of AI systems
• Easy to compute and interpret
• Works well as part of feature ensemble
• Consistent signal across AI models
limitations:
• Low standalone discriminative power
• Academic and scientific text naturally uses passive voice
• Modern LLMs can be prompted to avoid passive voice
• Language-specific (mainly English)

references.title: Herbold, S. et al. (2023). A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays. Scientific Reports.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
Biber, D. (1988). Variation Across Speech and Writing. Cambridge University Press.
